name: llama.cpp Vulkan NVIDIA TITAN V llama-2-7b Q4_0 tg128 noFA
methodology: COMMUNITY-SCOREBOARD (llama.cpp discussion #10879, maintainer-curated Vulkan backend). llama-bench llama-2-7b.Q4_0.gguf (TheBloke, 3.56 GiB, 6.74B params), pp512 and tg128, batch 1, ngl=99 full offload, Vulkan, flash attention off (-fa 0).
